title: Confidence Is Not a Promise: A Reference Audit of Typed Decision Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.36311v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Typed decision models return a probability distribution over options supplied by the caller, and software tends to act on that number as if it were a guarantee. We measure what it licenses, comparing the open-weight Laya, in five checkpoints, with Jev 1.13, available only through an API. A probability licenses a statement about groups of decisions, not about one decision, and a gate that promises an accuracy among the cases it decides alone keeps that promise only with a lower bound checked on data like its traffic. Across 190 exchangeable evaluations, a threshold chosen by point estimate breaks the promise in 147, Learn then Test keeps it in all of them, and a Beta lower-bound rule decides more items on average than Learn then Test in 128 and fewer in none, without its guarantee. Calibrated in English, Jev keeps a promise of 95% in 8 of 51 locales. Ordinary typing noise breaks a promise calibrated on clean text, and, in exploratory ru

translated_title: 置信度并非承诺：对类型化决策模型的参考审计
translated_abstract: 类型化决策模型返回的是调用方所提供选项之上的概率分布，而软件往往将这个数字当作一种保证来对待。我们测量了这一概率究竟许可了什么，将开放权重的 Laya（五个检查点）与仅能通过 API 访问的 Jev 1.13 进行了比较。一个概率所许可的是关于决策群体层面的陈述，而非关于单个决策的陈述；一个在其独立裁决的案例上承诺某准确率的门槛，只有在其流量相似的数据上检验过下界之后，才能守住这一承诺。在 190 次可交换评估中，由点估计选出的阈值在 147 次中打破了承诺，Learn then Test 在全部评估中都守住了承诺，而 Beta 下界规则在 128 次评估中平均裁决的项目多于 Learn then Test，且没有任何一次更少，但它并不具备相应的保证。在英语上校准的 Jev，在 51 个语言区域中仅有 8 个守住了 95% 的承诺。普通的输入噪声即可打破基于干净文本校准的承诺，而在探索性运行中……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 该审计研究表明，类型化决策模型输出的概率只许可群体层面的统计保证而非单次决策的承诺——点估计阈值在190次评估中有147次失守，Beta下界规则虽无保证却比Learn then Test裁决更多项目，而跨语言与输入噪声会轻易打破在干净英语文本上校准的准确率承诺。
en_tdlr: Auditing typed decision models shows that a returned probability licenses only group-level accuracy bounds, not per-decision guarantees: point-estimate thresholds break their promise in 147 of 190 evaluations, a Beta lower-bound rule decides more items than Learn-then-Test without any guarantee, and cross-locale shifts and ordinary typing noise easily break promises calibrated on clean English text.
